name: condorcet_minimal_predecessor_reciprocal_completion_separation
lines: R : Fin m → Fin m → Prop
H : Fin q → Fin q → Prop
hroot : ∀ (J : Finset (Fin m)), #J ≤ k → ∃ a ∉ J, ∀ b ∈ J, R a b
hminimal : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin m)), (∀ J ⊆ S, #J ≤ k → ∃ a ∈ S, a ∉ J ∧ ∀ b ∈ J, R a b) → S = univ
hmap : ∀ (a b : Fin m), R a b → H (f a) (f b)
hrepair : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin m)), #T = k + 1 → (¬∃ a ∉ T, ∀ b ∈ T, R a b) → ∃ x, ∀ a ∈ T, H x (f a) ∧ H (f a) x
⊢ ∃ w, (∀ (a : Fin q), 0 ≤ w a) ∧ ∀ (A : Finset (Fin q)), (WellFounded fun a b => H ↑a ↑b) → 2 * ∑ a ∈ A, w a < ∑ a, w a
⊢ ¬∃ n U, 0 < n ∧ (∀ (v : Fin n), WellFounded fun a b => H ↑a ↑b) ∧ ∀ (a : Fin q), n ≤ 2 * #{v | a ∈ U v}
hU : ∀ (v : Fin n), WellFounded fun a b => H ↑a ↑b
hhalf : ∀ (a : Fin q), n ≤ 2 * #{v | a ∈ U v}

steps.tactic:
classical
apply (condorcet_half_cover_acyclic_half_cover_duality q H).mp
rintro ⟨n, U, hn, hU, hhalf⟩
exact
  condorcet_minimal_predecessor_reciprocal_completion_exclusion m q n k hn hk R H f hroot hminimal hmap hrepair U hU
    hhalf

exact
  condorcet_minimal_predecessor_reciprocal_completion_exclusion m q n k hn hk R H f hroot hminimal hmap hrepair U hU
    hhalf
